description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing 'Brand' entities in a React-Redux application, including fetching, adding, updating, activating, and deleting brands, as well as handling form state and validation.

methods.name: brandChange
methods.description: Creates an action to change a brand form field value.

methods.name: brandEditChange
methods.description: Creates an action to change a brand edit form field value.

methods.name: fetchStoreBrands
methods.description: Fetches list of store brands from API.

methods.name: fetchBrands
methods.description: Fetches list of brands from API.

methods.name: fetchBrand
methods.description: Fetches a single brand by ID from API.

methods.name: fetchBrandsSelect
methods.description: Fetches brands for select input, formatted for dropdown.

methods.name: addBrand
methods.description: Validates and adds a new brand via API.

methods.name: updateBrand
methods.description: Validates and updates an existing brand via API.

methods.name: activateBrand
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a brand via API.
